source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how to build the largest, smallest, or closest possible large number under digit, divisibility, or card-use constraints.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Digit constraint is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how to build the largest, smallest, or closest possible large' is answered as digit constraint rather than place-value dominance.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Digit constraint is what produces place-value dominance, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how to build the largest, smallest, or closest.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: place-value dominance is settled by running 'Decide whether a button-click expression is a valid way to make a': A number can be made in many correct ways by adding click counts times powers of ten — on the item about Decide how to build the largest, smallest, or closest.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Place-value dominance is computed by squaring digit constraint and leaving place-value dominance linear, so the written value is 33 — on the item about Decide how to build the largest, smallest, or closest.

intelligence.enrichment: Place values on the left have the greatest effect on size, so maximum and minimum constructions arrange the allowed digits or values around the most important place positions while still satisfying constraints such as first digit not 0, last digit even, last digit 0 or 5, or each card used only once.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_07/ch_101.
